trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Small input storage combined with a requested view whose logical extents exceed that storage.
trigger_condition.memory_trigger: Custom size and stride metadata maps logical elements outside the allocated input tensor storage.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: A subsequent operation iterates over the malformed view, causing an out-of-bounds read.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Call aten::_reshape_alias with user-controlled sizes and strides on a small CPU tensor; ensure storage_offset + stride * (size - 1) exceeds storage bounds; follow with a materializing op such as sum().

bug_oracle.description: AddressSanitizer reports heap-buffer-overflow READ when the invalid view is accessed.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary view sizes and stride values, especially oversized or non-contiguous strides.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create small CPU tensors with known storage sizes and various dtypes; allocate storage exactly matching the input tensor boundaries.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject custom size and stride metadata that causes the reachable storage range of the view to exceed the input tensor storage.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run aten::_reshape_alias or similar view/alias operations with mutated metadata, then invoke a follow-up iteration or reduction operation such as sum().
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Use AddressSanitizer or another memory sanitizer to detect heap-buffer-overflow, out-of-bounds reads, or crashes.
